name_zh: 帝肯 Fluent 780 自动化液体工作站

dimension_evidence.dimensions: Overall length 1650 mm; footprint depth 780 mm; overall depth 923 mm; overall height on cabinet 1977 mm
dimension_evidence.uncertainty: Published nominal cabinet configuration. Product web page quotes 785 mm footprint and 1236 mm instrument height; the 923/1977 envelope follows this operating-manual configuration. Internal parts and optional arm inventory are photo-estimated, not manufacturer CAD.

author: Virtual Lab project contributors
license: Project-authored illustrative geometry; manufacturer reference images/documents remain Tecan copyright and are not texture assets.
notes: 780-specific 1650 mm cabinet, two front guard panels, 52-grid / 1300 mm usable X deck and 1520 mm X rails. Full-size source FCA8 and MCA96 subassemblies retain their local parents and 9 mm nozzle pitch; RGA is optional illustrative inventory. XYZ digital articulation is not hardware-calibrated. No side carousel from the reference photo is included.
axis: X right, Y back, Z up in Blender; standard Y-up glTF export

review.method: Actual final-model render inspected beside facility/manufacturer reference; no photographic texture substitution
review.note: 780 cabinet/deck width and three lower doors reviewed against Tecan standard photograph; full-size arms retained; optional layout not surveyed.
review.final_review_note: Final evaluated-geometry render reviewed after curve-envelope correction and modifier-preserving export. Shapes compared with the previously inspected facility/manufacturer contact sheets.
review.approval_policy: Visual approval binds to the exact exported GLB (geometry, materials, hierarchy and animation); PNG date/render-time metadata may change without changing the reviewed model.

surface_check.method: Actual evaluated vertices to triangles in both directions, closed pose; Euclidean metres; all posed transforms independently checked

assembly.units: m at asset root; local translation units follow accumulated parent scale
assembly.axis_metadata: joint_axis uses Blender Z-up node local coordinates; glTF Y-up equivalent is [x,z,-y]
